conjecture: Depth-d halo collapse: for an exact signed idempotent P with 0 < delta(P) <= 1/4 and nonempty visible set W(P), any row index v with d = dist_1(p_v, conv{p_w : w in W}), and any halo width a > 0, writing d_j = dist_1(p_j, conv W), sigma_a(v) = sum over {j : d_j > a*tau} of max(P_vj, 0) (tau = sqrt(delta)), sigma(v) = sum over {j : d_j > 0} of max(P_vj, 0), nu_v the row negative mass, and C_a(v) = sum over {j : d_j > a*tau, d_j > d} of max(P_vj, 0)*(d_j - d), one has d*(1 - sigma_a(v)) <= (sigma(v) - sigma_a(v))*a*tau + nu_v*(2 + 4*delta) + C_a(v).
